description: Trigger and behavior evals for the personal science-blog persona.

tests.prompt: We just finished researching rainbow shells around black holes - blog the journey for me.
grading_criteria: Saves the human<->assistant dialogue to journey/transcript.md (provenance, not part of paper.md)
Mines the owner's real questions/corrections into ranked blog-notes
Drafts a first-person post in the owner's voice that keeps the science correct
Does not fabricate questions, aha moments, or citations

tests.prompt: Turn what I learned in this session into a fun blog post I can publish.
grading_criteria: Follows the post arc (wrong model -> correction -> what's actually going on -> why it's cool)
Funny but scientifically accurate; technical terms glossed

tests.prompt: Blog the study in topic/old-study - it was done before we had the blog setup.
grading_criteria: Backfill mode: reconstructs the journey from paper.md + review/ artifacts
Labels reconstructed pieces and states gaps honestly rather than inventing dialogue

tests.prompt: Do a research study on whether coffee improves memory and open a PR.
